27ft Premium Center Console – Private Fishing Charter in San José del Cabo

1 to 4 people

The 27ft Premium Center Console is a private fishing charter designed for groups of up to four guests looking for a balance between sportfishing and onboard comfort in San José del Cabo.

Its open deck provides room to move while fishing, while comfortable seating and an onboard toilet make it a practical choice for couples, families, and small groups. The center-console layout allows anglers to enjoy the fishing experience without needing a much larger vessel.

Departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina, this charter offers opportunities to fish the waters of the Sea of Cortez. Depending on seasonal conditions, anglers may encounter yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, or marlin. Fishing techniques and locations are selected according to weather, sea conditions, and current fish activity.

Fishing equipment, bottled water, and soft drinks are included. Fishing licenses, bait, meals, transportation, and fish-cleaning arrangements should be confirmed before departure.

Private charter for 1–4 guests. Contact Exotic Fish Cabo to confirm availability, trip duration, and your final quotation.
